### Executive Summary
Vanderbilt University has instructed students to disconnect their devices following claims by a ransomware group regarding the theft of 1 million records. The incident was reported on November 10, 2026.

The identity of the ransomware group and the exact nature of the compromised records have not been officially confirmed. Threat intelligence teams are monitoring the situation as containment efforts proceed.

### Technical Impact & Root Cause
The initial access vector, specific ransomware variant, and underlying system vulnerabilities involved in this attack are currently not yet confirmed. 

The primary technical impact reported is the alleged exfiltration of 1 million records. The institution's directive for students to disconnect devices indicates active containment protocols aimed at isolating network segments and preventing further lateral movement or potential data exfiltration.

### Mitigation & IOCs
* Instruct users and students to immediately disconnect affected devices from the university network to assist in isolation and containment.
* Maintain network segment monitoring and review connection logs for unusual outbound data transfers or suspicious lateral activity.
